source.publisher: Larne Times (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: read on the page image (Larne Times, 19 May 1949, p. 5): 'the only new face on the Council will be Mr. W. J. Hawkins, J.P., Ballystrudder, Islandmagee, who has been nominated to represent Islandmagee South', succeeding H. J. S. Milliken, J.P.

note: Triennial election of the 16 electoral divisions of Larne rural district, one member each, polled on 2 June 1949. There were no contests: only five divisions returned nomination papers, and the retiring members in the others were deemed re-elected. W. J. Hawkins was the only new member, for Islandmagee South. New member, in place of H. J. S. Milliken, J.P., who retired after 20 years' service. Returned unopposed.
correctionNote: Corrected from the page image of the Larne Times, 19 May 1949, p. 5 (council-audit, Nov 2026): the new member's initials are W. J. (Mr. W. J. Hawkins, J.P.), not M. J.
